panels.title: Expert cache hit rate
panels.description: Slot lookups that found the expert resident, by tier; the second series is the share of experts computed on the CPU instead (ADR 0035); the third, decode admissions into the VRAM tier per VRAM lookup (ADR 0059, zero unless admit_share is set). Under the CPU miss policy and during decode only, the vram hit share is close to the decode VRAM pair share (prefill lookups mix in otherwise).

panels.title: Layers fully resident
panels.description: MoE layer steps with every top-k expert resident; decides whether whole-step graphs pay (ADR 0030).

panels.title: Expert load duration
panels.description: Time to bring one expert into a slot, by destination tier and source.

panels.title: Tier read bandwidth
panels.description: Bytes per second read from each memory tier; the second series is the part uploaded into VRAM slots by decode admissions (ADR 0059).

panels.title: Segments per step
panels.description: Mean graph segments per engine step; n_layer + 1 for the own builder (ADR 0030), 1 for libllama.

panels.title: Prefetch accuracy
panels.description: Share of the experts predicted one layer ahead (depth 1) or two (depth 2) that the router then chose, mean over layers (ADR 0038). Below about 0.4 the prefetch mostly wastes disk bandwidth.

panels.title: Prefetched experts
panels.description: Experts read ahead into the RAM tier per second, by result: issued, used (routed while resident) and wasted (evicted before they were routed). Wasted bytes per second on the second series.

panels.title: Speculation acceptance
panels.description: Share of drafted tokens the target accepted, per drafting method (ADR 0043). Below about 0.3 speculation likely costs more than it saves.

panels.title: Drafted and accepted tokens
panels.description: Tokens drafted for verification and accepted by the target per second, per drafting method (ADR 0043).

panels.title: Expert reads under compute
panels.description: Decode expert reads through the I/O service (ADR 0054): chunks in flight by class at each submit (p50), the share of the read span of a layer step the main thread did not wait for (p50; alert TetraederExpertReadsNotHidden below 0.3), and disk bytes read per decoded token. Few chunks in flight: the workers are starved by the CPU quota. Many in flight and a low hidden share: the disk is saturated.

panels.title: Predicted vs measured step time
panels.description: Planner prediction for the running plan against the measured decode step time, per stage (ADR 0042).

panels.title: Prediction residual
panels.description: Relative error |measured - predicted| / predicted of the step time per stage. Above 0.2 for 30 minutes fires TetraederPlanResidualHigh (recalibrate).

panels.title: Plan regret
panels.description: Step time of the running plan over the best known plan, minus 1. Phase 3a exit: at most 10%.

panels.title: Replans by trigger and outcome
panels.description: Replanning decisions (ADR 0042): switched, knobs_applied, rejected, rolled_back.

panels.title: Replan duration
panels.description: Drain, restart and health check of one plan switch.

panels.title: Bottleneck shares
panels.description: Share of the step time bound by each resource, from the detector (ADR 0041). A limit is normal; faults are below.

panels.title: Detector faults
panels.description: Detector windows that reported a fault, by class and resource. Environment faults (not model_mismatch) fire TetraederEnvironmentFault after 10 minutes.

panels.title: SLO burn rate
panels.description: Error ratio over the window divided by the error budget (slo.yml). Page above 14.4 (1h) or 6 (6h); ticket above 1 (3d).

panels.title: Error budget remaining
panels.description: Share of the 30 day error budget left per SLI; negative means the objective is missed.

panels.title: Prompt tokens from the prefix cache
Format conversion
panels.description: Tensors per second found in the conversion cache (hit) or converted at load (miss), and the mean seconds to convert one tensor (ADR 0047). A load of a new plan misses once per changed tensor; misses on every start mean the cache is not reused.

panels.title: Prefix cache (host RAM)
panels.description: Prefix hits per second by source (live sequence or a saved sequence restored from host RAM), saved sequences evicted per second, and host bytes held (ADR 0049). Evictions above RAM hits mean --cache-ram is too small for the traffic.

panels.title: Tool calls by outcome
panels.description: Tool calls per second by parser outcome (parsed, repaired, failed) and class (ok, unknown_tool, empty_call, no_opener, unclosed, bad_json, bad_xml), ADR 0051, ADR 0057. Repaired plus failed above 2% fires ToolCallFailures.

panels.title: KV cache
panels.description: KV cache bytes by format (ADR 0050 b) and tokens held of the tokens it can hold. Near 100% means requests are about to fail with context full (alert TetraederKvNearFull).

panels.title: CPU backend
panels.description: CPU backend variant in use (ADR 0052): tier, ISA features and dispatch mode, and the host features it lacks. IQK_MM in the ISA list means the iqk AVX-512 VNNI decode kernels for Q4_K and Q6_K experts are on (ADR 0053, switch GGML_CPU_IQK_MM=0). Missing above 0 for 5 minutes fires TetraederCpuVariantBelowHost.

panels.title: Admission and engine loads
panels.description: 1 while the server admits requests, 0 during a plan switch (alert TetraederAdmissionStopped), and the time to load the model into an engine by outcome (ADR 0055).

panels.title: Decode time per token by stage
panels.description: Mean host seconds per decoded token by stage (eval: backend step and logits readback; sample: constraint mask and sampling; emit: hand-off to the gateway), only while serve runs with TETRAEDER_DECODE_PROFILE=1 (docs/m1-open.md item 4). Sample above about 0.3 ms means the sampler, not the GPU, limits decode.

panels.title: Container CPU
panels.description: CPU cores the container's cgroup used against its quota, the engine's configured threads (tetraeder.cpu.threads; alert TetraederThreadsAboveQuota when they exceed the quota) and the CPU threadpool's polling level, 0 to 100 (tetraeder.cpu.poll, ADR 0061: auto picks 0 when the quota binds; alert TetraederCpuPollingUnderQuota when it spins at threads up to the quota). From the host sampler (scripts/engine_sample.py) and the builder.

panels.title: CPU throttling, steal and pressure
panels.description: Share of CFS periods throttled (alert TetraederCpuThrottled), host-wide steal share (alert TetraederCpuStealHigh) and the stall share of CPU and I/O pressure (PSI some and full): the CPU attribution fields of ADR 0058 over time.

panels.title: Busiest CPUs and clock
panels.description: Busy share of the eight busiest host CPUs (hostmetrics, every state but idle and wait; the container may see every host core) and the mean CPU clock.

panels.title: Disk reads and queue depth
panels.description: Read bytes per second by device (hostmetrics) and the mean queue depth (weighted I/O seconds per second), the inputs of disk_util and io_class (ADR 0058).

panels.title: Container memory
panels.description: The cgroup's memory against its limit (alert TetraederContainerMemoryNearLimit), its page cache and anonymous memory, and the engine process tree's RSS.

panels.title: Engine process tree
panels.description: Major page faults and context switches per second of the engine's process tree (all threads), from the host sampler.

panels.title: GPU utilization and memory
panels.description: nvidia-smi through the host sampler: busy share and memory used over its size.

panels.title: GPU power, temperature and clocks
panels.description: Board power, temperature and the SM and memory clocks; Vast clocks cannot be locked, so these explain drift between paired runs.

panels.title: GPU throttle reasons and PCIe link
panels.description: 1 while nvidia-smi reports the throttle reason (alert TetraederGpuThrottled for slowdown, thermal and power brake), and the PCIe link generation and width (a degraded link shows here).
